verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a public RESTful API for processing applicant data and documents. The docs say it gives full control over the verification flow, and a Sandbox mode with app tokens supports testing integrations. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found (all probed paths returned 404), little endpoint-level or authentication detail is in the pack, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: With the Sumsub API, you can process the applicant data and documents submitted for verification through simple RESTful APIs.
The Sumsub API lets you integrate identity verification directly into your product, giving you full control over the verification flow
Set up and test your integration using app tokens, webhooks, and our WebSDK.
